subject.title: [Bug]: macos say command in daemon not output to speakers

question: Should OpenClaw support audible Local CLI TTS from a macOS launchd/system daemon, and should that support be documentation-only or a product helper?
rationale: The code can run an operator-supplied wrapper today, but native session bridging would create macOS security/session policy and UID-selection behavior that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Document wrapper path
options.body: Document a supported Local CLI wrapper that discovers the active GUI user/session without hard-coded UIDs and require live macOS proof before closing.

options.title: Build plugin-owned helper
options.body: Add a macOS-specific Local CLI/helper path that owns GUI-session discovery and speaker playback, with tests plus live launchd proof.

options.title: Declare system daemon speaker playback unsupported
options.body: Keep Local CLI file-output behavior only and direct users to a logged-in LaunchAgent or custom wrapper for speaker playback.

recommendation.title: Document wrapper path
recommendation.body: Document a supported Local CLI wrapper that discovers the active GUI user/session without hard-coded UIDs and require live macOS proof before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the Local CLI TTS provider/docs and the macOS launchd service boundary where steipete has the strongest combined history signal.
